Frozen Potatoes (French Fry Cut and Diced)

Tufan Organik Frozen Potatoes (French Fry Cut and Diced) belongs to the Frozen Vegetables range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.

بطاطس مجمدة (أصابع رفيعة طويلة ومكعبات)

Tiefgefrorene Kartoffeln (Pommes-frites-Schnitt und Würfel)
